Company Profile : EMPG Projects Holdings Limited 
 
 
 Company name: EMPG Projects Holdings Limited 
 
 Date of incorporation: 20 th March, 2019 
 
 Registered office: Office 26, Level 3, Gate Village Building 10, Dubai International Financial Centre, Dubai, 500043, United Arab Emirates, Dubai 
 
 Type of business: EMPG Projects Holdings Limited is a n intermediate holding company , incorporated under the laws of Dubai International Financial Centre, UAE , for EMPG Holdings Limited which owns and operates bespoke digital online real estate portals, primarily in the MENA and South Asia regions . 
 
 Directors: Mark Nosworthy 
 
 Nosworthy is a C F O of EMPG Holdings Limited. Prior to this, Nosworthy was a part of Clicksco Group in the Middle East. 
 
 Aatif Rana 
 
 Rana is Head of Operations for property portal Bayut.com, which has become a highly successful enterprise operating across UAE .
